development_probe.interpretation: Fixed first 20 already-consumed ranking-v5 cases/profile; non-RL engineering diagnostic, not unseen evaluation or promotion. Feature/probe source committed before execution in 28b50f1.

learning_objective.initialization: Exact deterministic TemporalPublicGreedy scores plus zero residual; random hidden actor features, zero actor output and independent zero linear critic correction.
learning_objective.actor: temporal_marginal_return + .25*tanh(tanh(features@w1+b1)@wa), including STOP. Shared candidate scorer over variable legal sensor/site options.
learning_objective.sampling: Count-balanced softmax(score/.05 - deployment_indicator*log(number_of_legal_deployments)). Deterministic evaluation uses highest raw score, STOP wins ties; it is not the joint distribution mode.
learning_objective.critic: Independent public pooled legal-deployment/STOP feature linear baseline with public STOP return-to-go prior. Detached before-update sampled value; no critic-to-actor gradient path.
learning_objective.update: One original-return REINFORCE update per 16 complete episodes; no normalized advantages, entropy regularization, counterfactual branches, demonstration labels or auxiliary ranking loss. Separate actor/critic clipping and Adam moments.
learning_objective.scoring: Original frozen simulator, terminal reward, shaping, legal actions and mixed curriculum. New public feature schema v2; same sensor_input.v1 wire interface.
learning_objective.budget_rationale: Three fixed training seeds and 512 episodes each (32 updates each) form a bounded representation-and-objective pilot, not a compute-matched comparison. All three fixed endpoints evaluated; no best seed/checkpoint selection.

validation.confidence_interval: First average the three temporal endpoint metrics for each scenario, then resample paired scenario differences within each profile and average profile means equally. Two-sided 95% percentile intervals; conditional on these three trained endpoints, not population training-seed uncertainty.
validation.selection: All three fixed endpoints and source/input hashes bound before first validation case. No endpoint selection, ensemble action selection, early stopping, retraining, scenario filtering/replacement or reserved final-test access.

scale_gate.interpretation: All conditions must hold against all three comparators. Timely confirmation is primary. Profile timely/detection and individual-seed equal-profile timely point guards are not statistical noninferiority. Aggregate detection, all-threat success and original return must not decline. Passing supports further development only; it is not final-tested robustness or deployment approval.

limitations: Designed after inspecting already-consumed prior results. New validation is a development screen, not a reserved final test.
Temporal probabilities are exact only conditional on approximate public trajectories and declared emission correlation assumptions; not real-world calibration or knowledge of hidden paths.
Feature changes and learning-objective changes are combined. Compare against the matched non-RL temporal control to distinguish any learned benefit from the forecast prior.
Deterministic raw-score policy differs from training's count-balanced stochastic distribution; no convergence or policy-improvement guarantee.

Initial sequential sensor layout planning in synthetic cases. Timely confirmation means sensing, not interception. No native Unreal integration, physical device control, live sensor calibration or mid-flight relocation validation.
Three seeds do not characterize all training variability. No unseen-sensor performance claim follows solely from a variable-catalogue architecture.
